description: Render the monster's most recent spoken reply as a speech bubble positioned near the monster sprite (in/over the left .stage-area / .sprite-wrap), with a CSS tail (triangle) pointing toward the monster and a fade-in on new content. While a reply is awaited (chatPending) the bubble shows a typing state (…). The baby (幼年期) non-verbal canned reply is also surfaced in the bubble. Derive the latest reply text with a new pure helper in ui-helpers.ts, unit-tested in game-ui.test.ts. The ChatPanel transcript + input on the right are preserved; the bubble is an additional near-sprite presentation. No new runtime dependencies; UI stays Japanese-only.
steps: In packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts, add a pure helper `latestMonsterReply(chatLog: ReadonlyArray<{ role: 'player' | 'monster'; text: string }>): string | null` that returns the text of the LAST element whose role === 'monster', or null when there is none (empty log or only player lines). Keep it React/DOM-free (do not import ChatLine from the React hook; accept a structural subset so the test file can call it without React). Document it with a short JSDoc comment matching the style of the other helpers in this file.

In packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts, add tests for latestMonsterReply: (a) returns null for an empty log; (b) returns null when the log has only player lines; (c) returns the single monster line text; (d) with multiple monster lines interleaved with player lines, returns the TEXT OF THE LAST monster line; (e) returns the baby canned reply text '…！（まだ言葉を話せないみたい。もっと育ててあげよう！）' when that is the last monster line. Import latestMonsterReply alongside the existing imports.

Create a new presentational component packages/frontend/src/components/SpeechBubble.tsx. Props: { text: string | null; pending: boolean }. Behavior: when pending is true, render the bubble showing a typing indicator '…' (reuse the same '…' text used by ChatPanel's pending bubble). When pending is false and text is a non-empty string, render the bubble with that text. When pending is false and text is null/empty, render nothing (return null). Give the root element className 'speech-bubble' plus a 'pending' modifier class when pending. Use a key or React approach so the fade-in animation re-fires when the text content changes (e.g. key on the text/pending so a new reply remounts and replays the fade-in; follow the keyed-remount pattern used for care-fx in App.tsx). Set aria-live='polite' on the bubble (or a wrapper) so screen readers announce new replies; mark the decorative tail aria-hidden. Keep text wrapping/clamping graceful for long text via CSS (see styles step).

In packages/frontend/src/App.tsx, import SpeechBubble and render it inside the left .stage-area near the sprite — place it within .sprite-wrap (which is position: relative) so it can be absolutely positioned near/over the sprite, consistent with where 💤/💢 and the care-fx overlay already live. Pass text={latestMonsterReply(game.chatLog)} and pending={game.chatPending}. Import latestMonsterReply from ui-helpers.ts. Do not remove the existing sprite overlays. The bubble must auto-update whenever game.chatLog gains a new monster line or game.chatPending flips (both are already reactive state from useMonster).

Baby-stage behavior: the backend returns a canned non-verbal reply (text '…！（まだ言葉を話せないみたい。もっと育ててあげよう！）', modelId 'none') but the frontend currently never sends chat for baby (ChatPanel shows only the .chat-disabled-hint and sendChat early-returns because !stage.canChat). Keep baby.canChat === false and do NOT enable the baby input or regress the existing .chat-disabled-hint UX. Because baby produces no monster chatLog line, latestMonsterReply returns null and the bubble simply shows nothing for a baby that has not spoken — which is consistent. To satisfy the issue's requirement that the baby non-verbal response is expressed in the bubble, surface the canned non-verbal cue as the bubble content for the baby stage WITHOUT sending a Bedrock/backend request: e.g. in App.tsx compute the bubble text as `canChat(stageId) ? latestMonsterReply(game.chatLog) : BABY_SPEECH_TEXT` where BABY_SPEECH_TEXT is the exact canned string '…！（まだ言葉を話せないみたい。もっと育ててあげよう！）' (define it as a shared constant — prefer adding/exporting it from ui-helpers.ts so the test can reference the same literal and the backend-canned string is mirrored in one place with a comment noting the backend source packages/backend/src/handlers/chat.ts). For baby, pass pending={false}. Add a ui-helpers unit test asserting the exported baby constant equals that exact string. Keep this logic simple and clearly commented; do not alter sendChat or useMonster behavior.

In packages/frontend/src/styles.css, add styles for .speech-bubble: position: absolute near the top/upper area of .sprite-wrap (e.g. anchored above the sprite) so it reads as coming from the monster; a rounded bubble background consistent with the existing .chat-line.monster .chat-bubble palette (var(--panel-2)/var(--text)); max-width and word-wrap/overflow-wrap: break-word (and optionally a line clamp or max-height with overflow) so long or empty text wraps/clamps gracefully; pointer-events: none so it never blocks sprite interactions. Add a CSS tail using a ::after pseudo-element that renders a triangle (border trick) pointing toward the monster sprite (i.e. pointing downward if the bubble sits above the sprite, or sideways if beside it — pick one and keep the tail pointing at the sprite). Add a @keyframes fade-in (opacity 0->1, small translateY) applied to .speech-bubble so new content fades in; the keyed remount from the component step replays it. Add a '.speech-bubble.pending' subtle style for the typing state if desired. Wrap the fade-in/animation in a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` guard that disables the animation (optional but preferred, matching the care-fx reduced-motion consideration).
Confirm no new npm dependencies were added (check package.json files are unchanged except intended source files). Keep all user-facing strings Japanese.
acceptance_criteria: latestMonsterReply exists in ui-helpers.ts, is pure (no React/DOM imports), and returns the last monster line's text or null.
New unit tests for latestMonsterReply and the exported baby-speech constant pass; frontend `npm test` count increases above the 27 baseline with 0 failures.

A <SpeechBubble> component renders inside .sprite-wrap in App.tsx near the sprite and shows the latest monster reply; while chatPending it shows the '…' typing state; when there is no reply (and not pending, non-baby) it renders nothing.
The bubble has a CSS tail (triangle) pointing toward the monster sprite and a fade-in animation that replays when the reply text changes.
For a baby (幼年期) monster the bubble displays the exact canned non-verbal text '…！（まだ言葉を話せないみたい。もっと育ててあげよう！）', the chat input stays disabled, and the existing .chat-disabled-hint is not regressed.
No new runtime dependencies are introduced; all new UI strings are Japanese.
`npm run build` stays green and root `npm test` stays at 47/47.
findings: Implemented on branch feat/chat-speech-bubble, commit 6398439 (feat: show latest monster reply as a speech bubble near the sprite). Changes: (1) ui-helpers.ts adds pure, React/DOM-free `latestMonsterReply(chatLog)` (returns LAST monster line text or null) and exported constant `BABY_SPEECH_TEXT` mirroring the backend canned reply with a comment pointing at packages/backend/src/handlers/chat.ts (exact string '…！（まだ言葉を話せないみたい。もっと育ててあげよう！）'). (2) New presentational component components/SpeechBubble.tsx (props {text:string|null; pending:boolean}): pending->'…', text->text, else null; root className 'speech-bubble' (+'pending'), aria-live='polite', decorative tail aria-hidden; keyed on content so fade-in re-fires on new replies. Reuses the exact '…' pending cue from ChatPanel. (3) App.tsx mounts <SpeechBubble> inside .sprite-wrap next to the existing 💤/💢/care-fx overlays; text = canChat(stageId) ? latestMonsterReply(game.chatLog) : BABY_SPEECH_TEXT, pending = canChat(stageId) ? game.chatPending : false. useMonster/sendChat untouched; baby canChat stays false and ChatPanel disabled-hint unchanged. (4) styles.css adds .speech-bubble (absolute, anchored above sprite, var(--panel-2)/var(--text) palette, max-width, overflow-wrap:break-word + max-height clamp, pointer-events:none, downward CSS-border triangle tail toward sprite, speech-bubble-in fade/translateY keyframes, .pending dim, and a prefers-reduced-motion:reduce guard disabling the animation). No new runtime deps (no package.json changes); all strings Japanese. Verification: `npm run build` (root) exits 0; root `npm test` 47/47; `cd packages/frontend && npm test` 33/33 (6 new tests: latestMonsterReply empty/only-player/single/interleaved-last/baby-text + BABY_SPEECH_TEXT exact-literal assertion), 0 failures. Note: .agents/tasks/task-chat-speech-bubble/ left untracked (task-plan artifacts), consistent with FEAT-001. Not pushed; no PR (per constraints).
